events.prediction_text: Red Bull's four-time World Champion Max Verstappen has demonstrated unmatched tire management across the demanding high-speed sweeps of Circuit of The Americas, having won the United States Grand Prix three consecutive times. With Red Bull's upgraded aero package proving dominant in high-downforce sectors, Verstappen is the prime selection to triumph in Austin.
